Class TransitionProgress

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.tfx.pattern.TransitionProgress
public final class TransitionProgress extends Object
Encapsulates alpha progression with smooth transitions.

This class handles the common pattern of mapping global animation progress to position-specific alpha values with smooth gradient transitions.

  • Method Details

    • mapSpatial

      public float mapSpatial(float globalAlpha, float position, float maxRange)
      Maps spatial patterns where positions vary along a continuous dimension.

      Used for patterns like diagonal and radial where positions have a natural progression along some spatial dimension with a defined range.

      Parameters:
      globalAlpha - Global animation progress (0.0-1.0)
      position - Position along the pattern dimension
      maxRange - Maximum value for the position dimension
      Returns:
      The mapped alpha value (0.0-1.0)

    • mapRadial

      public float mapRadial(float globalAlpha, float distance, float maxRange)
      Maps radial patterns where smaller distances (closer to center) should be more active.
      Parameters:
      globalAlpha - Global animation progress (0.0-1.0)
      distance - Distance from center point
      maxRange - Maximum distance value
      Returns:
      The mapped alpha value (0.0-1.0)

    • mapThreshold

      public float mapThreshold(float globalAlpha, float cellThreshold)
      Maps discrete threshold patterns where cells have distinct activation thresholds.

      Used for patterns like checkerboard where cells belong to discrete categories with specific threshold values.

      Parameters:
      globalAlpha - Global animation progress (0.0-1.0)
      cellThreshold - The discrete threshold for this cell (e.g., 0.0 for white, 0.5 for black)
      Returns:
      The mapped alpha value (0.0-1.0)
